resources.name: measures-measures
resources.title: Measures: one row per (8-digit ITC(HS) code, import-compliance measure)

fields.name: hs8
fields.description: 8-digit ITC(HS) 2022 code

fields.name: hs6
fields.description: 6-digit HS prefix (join key to data/hs6)

fields.name: measure_type
fields.description: import_policy, policy_condition, bis_isi_qco, bis_crs, bis_scheme_x, bis_upcoming_qco, tec_mtcte, bee_label, import_monitoring, other_condition

fields.name: measure_value
fields.description: Free, Restricted, Prohibited or STE for import_policy (blank if the source line has no policy); otherwise the IS number, monitoring system or keyword

fields.name: condition_text
fields.description: Verbatim condition text from the source, HTML stripped

fields.name: document_code
fields.description: Short stable code for the certificate or registration; defined in docs/document-codes.md

fields.name: legal_ref
fields.description: S.O. number, DGFT notification number or list entry as printed; never blank for bis_* types

fields.name: valid_from
fields.description: Notification or enforcement date, when the source gives one

fields.name: valid_to
fields.description: Rescission date; blank means open

fields.name: status
fields.description: in_force, upcoming or withdrawn

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: official: stated in official text for this code; candidate: keyword match, not a determination

fields.name: basis
fields.description: How the row was derived (row condition, chapter condition N, candidate: keyword ...)

fields.name: qco_slug
fields.description: Key into data/qco/register.csv when the measure is tied to a QCO register record

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: Repository file(s) the row was derived from, semicolon-separated

fields.name: source_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of each source_file as published here, same order, semicolon-separated

fields.name: as_of
fields.description: Date the ITC(HS) source was retrieved

fields.name: sha256
fields.description: sha256 of the published CSV

fields.name: source_rows
fields.description: Rows the source itself counts; equals rows

fields.name: page_date
fields.description: "Last updated" date the page prints, if any

fields.name: raw_file
fields.description: Path of the archived raw copy

fields.name: raw_sha256
fields.description: sha256 of the raw copy

fields.name: fetch_method
fields.description: direct, or alterlab when the origin refused the direct fetch; empty on rows written before this column existed

fields.name: fetch_tier
fields.description: scraping tier used by the fallback; empty for a direct fetch

fields.name: fetch_cost_usd
fields.description: cost of the fallback fetch in US dollars; empty for a direct fetch

resources.name: qco-register
resources.title: QCO register: one record per Quality Control Order (or list)

fields.name: pdf_urls
fields.description: Gazette PDF URLs, " ; " separated

fields.name: gazette_pdf_sha256
fields.description: sha256 of each Gazette PDF, " ; " separated, aligned with pdf_urls; empty where the file could not be fetched

fields.name: sha256
fields.description: sha256 of the published CSV

fields.name: source_rows
fields.description: Rows the source itself counts; equals rows

fields.name: page_date
fields.description: "Last updated" date the page prints, if any

fields.name: raw_file
fields.description: Path of the archived raw copy

fields.name: raw_sha256
fields.description: sha256 of the raw copy

fields.name: fetch_method
fields.description: direct, or alterlab when the origin refused the direct fetch; empty on rows written before this column existed

fields.name: fetch_tier
fields.description: scraping tier used by the fallback; empty for a direct fetch

fields.name: fetch_cost_usd
fields.description: cost of the fallback fetch in US dollars; empty for a direct fetch

fields.name: product_name
fields.description: Product or item as the official list words it

fields.name: is_codes
fields.description: Indian Standard (IS) codes as printed; blank where the list gives none

fields.name: scheme
fields.description: Scheme or list the row belongs to

fields.name: authority
fields.description: Administering authority as printed or inferred from the list page

fields.name: group
fields.description: Section or group title on the source page

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: URL of the source page or document

fields.name: retrieved_on
fields.description: Date the source was fetched (or the archive copy was taken)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status taken from the source page's own words

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Remaining source text: notification, dates, requirement; verbatim where quoted
